description:
1. Create a workspace folder named "temp_inspect" for all intermediate artifacts.  
2. Copy the target file "/root/matrix.txt" into "temp_inspect" as "matrix_copy.txt".  
3. Extract and save the original file metadata (size, modification time, permissions) to "temp_inspect/matrix_copy.meta".  
4. Produce a normalized version that standardizes line endings and trims trailing empty lines, saving it as "temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.txt".  
5. Save a head preview of the first 50 lines to "temp_inspect/preview_head.txt" and a tail preview of the last 50 lines to "temp_inspect/preview_tail.txt".  
6. Compute and record checksums for both "matrix_copy.txt" and "matrix_normalized.txt" into "temp_inspect/matrix_copy.checksum" and "temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.checksum".  
7. Compare the recorded checksums and metadata, and write a concise verification report of any differences to "temp_inspect/verification_report.txt".  
8. Create a summary file "temp_inspect/ready_to_count.txt" listing the prepared normalized file path and all verification artifacts, indicating the dataset is ready for a final line count.

How many lines are there in /root/matrix.txt
